speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss, along with an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. To help narrow down the cause, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any abdominal swelling or a feeling of fullness after eating small meals? I also need to know if you have experienced any shortness of breath or a persistent cough.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy confirms B-cell origin with high proliferation, and the imaging shows widespread lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly. This clinical picture is highly suggestive of a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, such as Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
